The Mallet of Zul'Farrak

To create the Mallet of Zul'Farrak, one must first travel to the Altar of Zul and obtain the sacred mallet from a troll Keeper.

Next, one must bring the sacred mallet to the altar atop of the troll city of Jintha'alor.

Using the sacred mallet at the altar will infuse it with power, and transform it into the Mallet of Zul'Farrak.

The Earthmother, her heart heavy with her children's' plight, could not bear to watch them fall from grace. In her grief, she tore out her eyes and set them spinning across the endless, starry skies. An'she and Mu'sha, seeking to ease the other's sorrow, could only chase each other's faint glow across the sky. The twins still chase one another with every turning of the world.

Though sightless, the Earthmother could not long stray from the world of her heart. She kept her ear to the winds and listened to all that transpired across the fields of the dawn. Her great heart was always with her children - and her loving wisdom never fled from them.

In time, the child, Cenarius, grew to the stature of his proud father. A brother to both the trees and the stars, the great hunter roamed the far places of the world, singing the harmonious songs of the dawning. All creatures bowed before his grace and beauty - there were none so cunning as the son of the moon and the white stag.

Eventually, Cenarius befriended the Shu'halo and spoke to them of the turning world. The children of the earth knew him as brother and swore to help him care for the fields of life and the favored creatures of their great Earthmother.

Cenarius taught the children of the earth to speak to the trees and plants. The Shu'halo became druids and worked great deeds of magic to nurse the land to health. For many generations the Shu'halo hunted with Cenarius and kept the world safe from the shadows that stirred beneath it.

The Earthmother's eyes shone down upon the lands she had breathed into creation. Her right eye, An'she (the sun), gave warmth and light to the land. Her left eye, Mu'sha (the moon), gave peace and sleep to the stirring creatures of the dawning. Such was the power of her gaze that the Earthmother closed one dreaming eye for every turning of the sky. Thus, her loving gaze turned day into night for the first dawning of the world.

While the right eye shone down upon the golden dawn, the Earthmother's gentle hands spread out across the golden plains. Wherever the shadow of her arms passed, a noble people arose from the rich soil. The Shu'halo (the tauren) arose to give thanks and prayer to their loving mother. There, in the endless fields of dawn, the children of the earth swore themselves to her grace and vowed to bless her name until the final darkening of the world.

Into the brave hearts of her pure children, the Earthmother placed the love of the hunt. For the creatures of the first dawn were savage and fierce. They hid from the Earthmother, finding solace in the shadows and the wild places of the land. The Shu'halo hunted these beasts wherever they could be found and tamed them with the Earthmother's blessing.

1.title: The White Stag and the Moon

texts.text: One great spirit eluded them, however. Apa'ro (known as Malorne to the night elves), was a proud stag of snow white fur. His antlers scraped the roof of the heavens and his mighty hooves stamped out the deep places of the world. The Shu'halo hunted Apa'ro to the corners of the dawning world - and closed in to snare the proud stag.

2.title: The White Stag and the Moon

texts.text: Seeking to escape, the great stag leapt into the sky. Yet, as his escape seemed assured, his mighty antlers tangled in the stars which held him fast. Though he kicked and struggled, Apa'ro could not loose himself from the heavens. It was then that Mu'sha found him as she chased her brother, An'she, towards the dawn. Mu'sha saw the mighty stag as he struggled and fell in love with him immediately.

3.title: The White Stag and the Moon

texts.text:
The clever moon made a bargain with the great stag - she would set him free from the snare of the stars if he would love her and end her loneliness.

Mu'sha loved Apa'ro and conceived a child by him. The child, a demigod some would claim, was born in the shadowed forests of the night. He would be called Cenarius, and walk the starry path between the waking world and the kingdom of the heavens.

4.title: The White Stag and the Moon

texts.text: As the mists of dawn faded and the Age of Memory advanced, the demigod, Cenarius, went his own way through the fields of the world. The Shu'halo (tauren) were sorrowful at his passing and forgot much of the druidism he had taught them. As the generations passed, they forgot how to speak with the trees and the wild things of the land. The dark whispers from the deeps of the world drifted up to their ears once again.

Though the children of the earth closed out the evil whisperings, a terrible curse befell their roaming tribes. Out of the black lands of the west came a horde of murderous creatures - the centaur. Cannibals and ravagers, the centaur fell upon the Shu'halo like a plague. Though the braves and hunters fought with the Earthmother's blessing in their hearts, the centaur could not be defeated.

The Shu'halo were forced to leave their ancestral holdings behind, and roam the endless plains as nomads forever after. It was held that one day hope would return - and the scattered tribes of the Shu'halo would find a new home under the loving arms of the Earthmother.
Cast out what rots away the body, and that which corrupts the spirit. Only then may you return.

npc:10136.text: Lady Sylvanas has ordered the investigation of some of the natural phenomena of Azeroth. She feels there is something great to be learned from its secretive past.$B$BI know not how she learned such things, but I trust her completely, so I will do my best.$B$BI am currently investigating slimes, oozes and such. The creatures all seem to be similar in make up, but greatly affected by their environment.$B$BI could use your help in gathering samples of the creatures..

npc:11044.text: Once, it is true, I was human. What might otherwise be a shortcoming works to our advantage, $n, for I know human weaknesses intimately.

Your knowledge of potions has exceeded mine, but you still have much to learn. Go up the stairs to the southeast and see Doctor Marsh. He will teach you true sufferi--ahem. He is a Forsaken who will train you further.

npc:11046.text: They called me stupid, but I'll show them. I'm going to watch every pot I have and prove that they can all boil stuff anyway. Yeah, I'm on a roll! Who's stupid now, huh? Huh!?

npc:11098.text: We cannot afford to give an inch in this war. Day and night, I create new armor, and I patch whatever can be salvaged from the old. I have no time for other tasks. Would you take care of something for me?

npc:11116.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

npc:11118.text: Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

npc:11139.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:11185.text: If you need any engineering supplies, I've got you covered.

npc:11801.text: Don't listen to the hearts of the world - the answer lies within.  You know the truth.

npc:11802.text: Greetings, $c.  You are welcome in Nighthaven, as well as all of Moonglade.  The Cenarion Circle welcomes all beings who respect the authority and command of nature.$B$BWhile you are here, please be sure to preserve the balance in all things.  Disturbances are not welcome here, and our wardens are trained to cease all hostilities without question.

npc:11899.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:12919.text:
If you ask me, the best part about fishing is its slow pace.  It gives one time to think, to reflect on past events and to plan for future ones.

Oh, and it's also a great excuse to drink.  Heavily.

npc:12920.text: It is good to see you again, Doctor $n. I have been following your progress and I dare say that it is time you learned some of the more advanced bandaging techniques.$B$BReturn to me from time to time, as your skill advances, and I shall teach you all that I know.
Greetings, $n. I am Doctor Gregory Victor, head trauma surgeon of Horde Trauma.
You have learned all that I am able to teach you at this time, Doctor $n. Return to me when your practice has expanded and I shall train you in the ways of the more advanced medicinal arts.

npc:14637.text: Maybe this wasn't the best place for a shop after all...

npc:14738.text: I've got all the cooking supplies you'll ever need, mon!

npc:15350.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

npc:16227.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:228216.text: <Nami is preoccupied, adjusting the viewfinder of the gigantic telescope.>

npc:2352.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:2388.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

npc:2389.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:243815.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

npc:243855.text:
I am Toron Rockhoof, and I serve as the smith for all tasks here at the summit.

Recently, matters have become... tense. I do not usually involve myself in politics, but it seems that there is a good deal of mistrust. Several druids have left to join a new faction, following one who calls himself the Wild King.

If the other druids do not sort out their problems, they may not be able to keep the summit protected!

npc:244511.text: Dem great battles come an' go. Now alls we left wit be da pains o' war and da cleanup needed to make sure none of them scourge be creepin' towards us no longer.

npc:2457.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us $g sir : ma'am;?
No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

npc:249235.text:
I've got plenty to do around here, but there's always time for visitors interested in technology. The shop has certainly been more orderly than you see it now, but without my mentor Yaely around anymore I don't have anyone to nag me to pick up after myself. 

Ah... to go back to the pre-war days.

npc:2496.text: Welcome to Booty Bay, partner.  I hope your stay in my town is enjoyable and uneventful - emphasis on the latter.  We've got plenty of drink if you're thirsty, and plenty of bouncers if you're antsy.$B$BNow then... what can this humble servant of the Steamwheedle Cartel do for you?  Better still - what can you do for me, eh?

npc:254915.text: Only the most arrogant of fools would try to subjugate nature herself to the yoke of control.

npc:255038.text:
Mortal, thank you. The vitality within you gives me the will to reform what presence of myself I still recognize as my own.

Tormented for years with undeath, my entire existence was haunting these hills and shambling endlessly. Tracing back my history with you is gradually helping clear the cobwebs of this dusty memory.

The war raging across this mountain years ago took with it countless lives. The damage can't be quantified, but to think of what more misery could have yet still occurred if Archimonde, and not our forces, were victorious.

In the midst of battle, you may see a glimpse of massacre about to happen, with a chance to stop it. A quick decision, an order shouted, an arrow released, a blow deflected. During the battle that raged across Mount Hyjal, strategic retreats are all we had to slow the advancing undead and allow our defenders more time to prepare.

Our barricades were starting to break, and our front line was close to being overrun. My childhood friend Tobin, who had been paired up with me ever since basic training, was positioned at an overlook tower over our established stronghold. I was supporting our flank, with our riflemen and siege engines.

Our commanders behind us signaled for a retreat, so our forces began to rotate away from the front line, and towards the narrow chokepoint granting an escape path. A massive frost wyrm crested over the mountain...

<The war veteran pauses for a prolonged time.>

It's too dark there yet.

Tobin's presence in the battle is still blocked in my mind... I only have the good memories of our younger years bleeding back into my soul.

npc:255151.text:
Greetings, traveler.

If you are looking to procure supplies from the Guardians of Hyjal, either myself or Aisarra should be able to assist. She can provide tradeskill plans to those who have proven themselves worthy, while I offer other goods that do not require a crafter's expertise.

npc:255693.text: Do not trouble me, mundane one!

npc:255993.text: As experienced as one might be, I urge you to travel with caution. These plains are home to ferocious beasts and others who seek to remove us from these lands. Even the skies have become too dangerous for our wyverns.

npc:256222.text: Greetings, traveler. The road to Mount Hyjal is long and dangerous. You may rest in the shelter of this cave, if you wish. I am a friend to all who come in peace.

npc:256390.text: We've had trouble with shipments going missing across Azeroth. If you find any, I'd appreciate if you could return them to me.

npc:256627.text: Barkskin survive because we honor the mountain, and heed what it says. Are you calm enough inside to listen?

npc:256629.text: Come to trade with the Barkskin, have you?

npc:256646.text: I have seen your kind, like folk that make their homes above ours. Our fight is with the Deadwood, not you, one of short-claws.

npc:256650.text: The wild provides, but it also devours. Where do you tread?

npc:256660.text: Mount Hyjal's woods and eyes have much to teach. We have more to learn, and you the same.

npc:256978.text:
We are last of our kind. Barkskin still stand, with no rot like Deadwood. Yet same doom weigh on us. You folk think all furbolg foul.

Doubt makes hearts hard. My kin strike at all who come near, in fear of tricks.

But, you may walk soft, show true, grow trust. Prove self strong. Then Barkskin call you friend, not foe.

You must find way to show you both fight same side. Barkskin may strike now, but if you stay strong, you will find ways.

Do not harm barkskin kin, or you lose all hope to make them friend.

Start with Deadwood. They roam much of Hyjal. Deadwood are foe of pure furbolg kin. Slay them, and Barkskin see you true.

npc:257558.text:
Ah, it's been some time since we've had adventurers roam these halls. Welcome to Farholde Keep. Enjoy these comforts while you can. I'm sure you've seen the conditions we're forced to keep.

It seems every day we lose more of our home to the ever-growing infestation of Horde mongrels and Light-forsaken Twilight's Hammer cultists. With those cowards in Stormwind hiding behind their walls, we are forced to bring order to these beasts ourselves.

Perhaps you'd like to put some of those $c talents to use?

npc:257591.text: Greetings, $c. As advisor to Demar, I would be happy to answer any questions you have about Farholde Keep.

npc:257595.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:259695.text: In order to change one's station one must be willing to outwit their opponents! Thankfully in this case, demons aren't nearly as clever as we are so that shouldn't be a problem. They are, however, extremely fun to torment.

npc:260661.text: If you wish to learn, show us how you are here to help.

npc:263757.text: <Felflick's eyes bore into you, an oily grin plastered over sharp teeth.>
Look, if you want me to talk then you gotta do something for me, yeah?

npc:264089.text:
For years our allies fought against the Scourge and demonic presence threatening the mountain. Though the days of battle have passed, Grimroot and I swore to protect against any remaining threats. With a small scourge presence just ahead, we'll remain here until they are no more.

When entering the nearby camp, do keep an eye out for Grim. He means well, but he's quite stubborn. Though the infection took most of his sight and strength he refuses to stop his patrols. Thick bark hides scars well.

I worry for him so.

npc:264795.text:
The work to rebuild and heal Hyjal begins inside of us. We cannot walk through this summit with poison in the heart, or vengeance on the mind. 

Much energy is spent trying to match the fury of an enemy.

What can we do to unwind old injuries, to help restore this land?

npc:265862.text: <Enho looks to be sleeping, but his eyes crack open a fraction as you approach.>

<Enho reaches out a slow, shaky hand to try to take the poultice. He wheezes with the effort and grits his teeth. It is clear he is in immense pain.

He does his best to drink the poultice. After a few small gulps, his features relax slightly as he sighs in relief.

He gives you a weak grunt of thanks, then returns to sleep.>

npc:265883.text: Every day it's the same thing: Pound this bar, grind this metal. One of these days I'd like a chance to use these axes and hammers in combat! Blacksmithing may be an honorable profession, but there's nothing to get the blood pumping like a real fight.

npc:265895.text:
<Maruke runs a gentle hand through Dendarro's black fur, and looks up to regard you with curious and defensive eyes.>

Can I help you?

Thank you, stranger. I would not want Dendarro's last moments to be in pain.

<Maruke's voice wavers slightly.>

Dendarro will...likely not last the night. He is all I have left to remember my mate by.
With his passing, only memories will remain.

<Maruke places a gentle hand on Dendarro. She bows her head, and she blinks back tears.>

Oh, Dazgrul. I am so sorry I could not protect our small family.

npc:267097.text: If this is what we call a victory, it would consume you to know the possible breadth of defeat...

npc:267121.text: The remains of a clan should be honored, not trodden upon by demons.

npc:267158.text: If it isn't my--I mean, my follower's underwing! What can the 'Queen of Corvids' do for you, hmm?

npc:267291.text:
<Upon walking up to this raptor, it turns to regard you. This one seems younger than the other two, and does not have scars and scratched scales like its two counterparts. It holds itself a bit higher, perhaps to look more fearsome.

It sways back and forth, clearly brimming with energy and ready to be released into the world. It seems excited about the prospect of having a companion that has an adventurous spirit.

Your adventurous spirit seems to have impressed this raptor, and it will accept you as both a friend and rider.>

npc:267297.text:
<As you approach, the golden eyes of this raptor follow you with a wicked glint. Its nostrils flare and it lets out a grumble. 

Without a second of warning, it lashes out its great tail and smacks the raptor next to it, causing the other creature to roar in displeasure and snap its teeth. The raptor before you looks entirely amused as the one beside it is reprimanded by the handlers. It is clear that this raptor will need a firm hand and a confident rider with its rebellious nature.

It seems pleased when its mischievous personality does not immediately turn you away. It inclines its head toward you, a sign that it will happily bear you as both a friend and a rider.>

npc:267298.text:
<As you approach, this raptor snaps its jaws at you, revealing its long and incredibly sharp teeth. It then growls at you with a challenging gleam in its intelligent eyes. When you do not immediately turn and flee, it looks pleased.

It fixes you with its great golden eyes, and it feels as if it is evaluating you. The raptor taps its long scythe-like talons on the ground in a strange rhythm. With a snort, the raptor lowers its head towards you and clicks its teeth together.

It seems this raptor is impressed by your ferocity and will accept you as both a friend and rider.>

npc:269127.text:
If you've tried to enter Dalaran, you've likely met with the Kirin Tor guards. They are under strict orders not to let outsiders into the city while this disruption runs rampant. The council has decreed that keeping up appearances is more important than preventing a catastrophe.

I suffer no such delusions.

npc:270582.text:
Greetings, $c.

I can show you how to weave magic about yourself to change the appearance of your equipment, if you so desire. Do you wish to utilize my services?

npc:272633.text: The ebb and flow of magic has been disrupted, of late. I hear that even the mages of Dalaran are perplexed. Is this disturbance arcane in nature, or are the elements themselves in unrest?

npc:275243.text: Apologies, $Gsir:madam;. The bank isn't open yet. Please come back later, if you don't mind.

npc:2879.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

You can't teach an old dog new tricks.  At least that's what someone once told me.  Lucky for you, I've discovered it to be untrue.$b$bHowever, pets do tend to get resistant to the technique, and I need more food each time to keep them happy.  What that means is that you'll owe me more money the more times I untrain the same pet.$b$bNow then, would you like me to start untraining?

npc:2995.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

npc:3031.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

npc:3216.text: Listen closely to what you are told and do not quickly trust, or distrust.  For even friends serve their own ends, $c.$B$BOur great Warchief knows this, and to prove that there are warlocks within the Horde who do not wish to destroy it from within or gain control over it, I have volunteered to aid our young leader in anyway I can.

npc:3309.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.
I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?
Would you rather trust your goods with a goblin?

npc:3310.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

npc:3347.text: You're talking to the wrong orc. I don't train novices. Talk to young Whuut over there... and use small words.

npc:3363.text: About time you showed me some results! Now I'll show you results!

npc:3368.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

npc:3399.text: Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.

npc:3615.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

npc:40833.text: All of Kalimdor gazes upon the peaks of Hyjal. With our guiding hands, we must ensure nature has these pristine snow-packed mountains to drink from for our future, as well.

npc:41861.text: It takes a well-trained mount to navigate Mount Hyjal's squalls.

npc:4314.text: What can I do for you $c?
You scared the fish away!  What do you want?

npc:4453.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.
Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a skyborne.

npc:4551.text: How may I be of service?

npc:4552.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!
Dirge Quikcleave of Gadgetzan is a master of the culinary arts.  To better yourself you will need to seek him out.
Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.

npc:4609.text: Here to learn? Very well. I suppose you can't cause our allies much harm if I teach you. Just as long as you actually do manage to harm our enemies.
With Algernon to keep me supplied, I can do all my work here without hunting for a single herb. If I never have to see the wonders of nature again, it won't be too soon.

npc:4611.text: Ready for training? Then try to keep up, $n. We've got a lot of ground to cover.

Incredible. Your potions display a knowledge that rivals my own. I cannot train you further, but talk to the orc Rogvar of Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows. He's known for his cutting-edge experiments.

npc:5515.text: Look at the wisdom and knowledge of the beast, and you will see yourself. Observe as the owl does, learn cleverness from the sabercat, embody the mighty spirit of the wolf.

npc:5694.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

npc:5769.text: The earth keeps many secrets, $c; it is our duty to ensure that those that must remain a secret for the good of all stays as such.

npc:5883.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

npc:6546.text: Your errand must mean much, $c, to draw you so deep into the marsh...

npc:6568.text: If tailoring is your thing, Vizzklick will most definitely have your supplies. Take a look around, $n, and let me know if you wish to purchase something!

npc:6740.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

npc:6929.text: If we are to make these new lands ours then we must have places to rest our battle weary bodies. Lay your axe by the fire and share the stories of your mighty battles.

npc:7010.text: These are dangerous times, skyborne.  An ancient evil is rising, and it cares not if you're Horde or Alliance.

npc:7311.text: Greetings, $c.  I pity your kind, for the secrets of true magic are beyond you...
Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

npc:738.text: This is a dangerous place, $n. Be careful around here.

npc:7733.text: Ah a visitor! Must be an adventurer, we don't get many tourists down this way. Grab a chair and a drink, make yourself comfortable. Say, you look like you have some meat on your bones. You thinkin about competing in the cage matches?

npc:7776.text: Listen to the stories of an elder. $N. I have many to speak of...

npc:7804.text:
Sul'thraze... the first time I heard the word uttered I was around your age. It meant nothing to me then, as it means nothing to you now. It was not until a warband of trolls coming from Zul'Farrak laid waste to the land that I understood... and feared.

Many will tell you that the Splitblade of Suffering does not exist. That it's a myth; a rumor started to scare children 'straight.' But believe me, skyborne, it exists.

<Trenton loses focus as he runs his hand across the jagged scar on his face.>

Sul'thraze... the first time I heard the word uttered I was around your age. It meant nothing to me then, as it means nothing to you now. It was not until a warband of trolls coming from Zul'Farrak laid waste to the land that I understood... and feared.$B$BMany will tell you that the Splitblade of Suffering does not exist. That it's a myth; a rumor started to scare children 'straight.' But believe me, $r, it exists.$B$B<Trenton loses focus as he runs his hand across the jagged scar on his face.>

npc:7824.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:7853.text: Hello, $n! I am master engineer, Scooty.

npc:7854.text: Welcome to Camp Mojache, brave $c.  How may I assist you this day?

npc:7875.text: We must ensure the survival of this camp at all costs, $c!  Our enemies must not be given any quarter, for they would surely give us none were we to need it.

npc:7952.text: And a good day to ya, brave $c.  I know ya be lookin' for a fine steed.  There's no finer steed than a raptor under your reigns, lemme tell you sis!  Take a look at the ones I got to offer - bred from the fiercest stock anywhere.

npc:7953.text: I can teach you the finer points of Raptor Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

npc:8020.text: Where would you like to fly to?

npc:8115.text:
Incredible power can be found in the spirits or "muisek" of the creatures that we battle against.

Look inside yourself; learn to harness the power of your own spirit, and you will be more powerful than you ever imagined.

Existing in this area are many creatures considered allies of the night elves. The elves have had access to the power within each of these creatures; it is time that the horde be allowed this same satisfaction. I have devised a way that this power can be captured and used for our benefit.

Do not doubt what I tell you, $N. Help me, and you shall see that I speak truth.

npc:8125.text: We may have been suffering a drought but there's no shortage of meat! Care to browse my goods?

npc:8142.text: $N, how may I further your training in the eyes of the Earth Mother?

npc:8579.text: Greetings, $c.  Though time and drink have dulled my outer senses, my inner eyes remain strong.

npc:9501.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

object:631197.text: <The well is crude but functional. The axle squeaks while it's turned, and the rope tends to catch. It could definitely do with an upgrade.>

object:654121.text: An aging, finely detailed leather scabbard rests on the stone.

npc:2216.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

npc:2263.text: I hope you're here to work, $C.  We have a lot to do and the Horde, the Syndicate and the Ogres aren't going to help us.

npc:2498.text: What what?!?  We all have profit to make... and we won't do it by standing idle.

npc:260825.text: Greetings, friend. It is good to see new faces on the mountain again, though I wish I could say times were less dire. I would be grateful for any help you can lend, if you are offering aid.

npc:3188.text: There is something you wish to discuss, $c... come, sit by me.

npc:5204.text: If we are to make our place in this world, then we will do so through study, and through the will to ignore our fading human instincts.

npc:737.text: Well, hello there. You seem like you wouldn't be opposed to making some coin, hm? I can tell from the look in your eyes. I am Mogul Kebok, overseer of operations in Azeroth, and if it is riches you seek, perhaps I can make arrangements.

npc:7407.text: The name's Bilgewhizzle, and I am the chief engineer of the Gadgetzan Water Company.  What can I assist you with?

npc:773.text: $C, eh? I am Krazek, Baron Revilgaz's secretary. I know everything about the goings on in this jungle and beyond. Perhaps you'd be interested in knowing the going price on oil in Ratchet? No? Looking for work, maybe? I can help you there.

npc:7777.text: The Gordunni Ogres encroach upon our lands.  We send as many as are willing to face them in the desecrated ruins of Feralas.

npc:7876.text: Some people wonder what we're doing out here in the desert.  Well... if I told you, then you'd stay and try to make our profits!

accept.text: I possess original packaging materials for the ripple Dran Droffers seeks.  I will assist you in packaging the ripple for Malton's abrasive father... for a fee of two additional bottles of said ripple.  They are located in crates found in the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock.$B$BIt will be an arduous task, to wit; foul slimes and oozes will be found sticking to the ruins; rumor has it they are led by some sort of master ooze.  Regardless, procure the ripple and return to me here for packaging.

objectives.text: Recover 10 bottles of Hinterlands Honey Ripple from the crates located around the abandoned Horde base in Skulk Rock.

accept.text: Damn trolls! They've been killing off our agents in the jungle! I've already lost a good number of my best guards to skirmishes with them. The costs are piling up! How will I explain this to Baron Revilgaz?$b$bDecisive action... Think, Kebok... you weren't assigned to the post you have today for sitting around... I've got it! You... $n, is it? You'll help me, won't you? There's money to be had!$b$bHere's the deal... you bring me the ears of fifteen Bloodscalp Trolls, and I'll compensate you well.

objectives.text: Acquire 15 Bloodscalp Ears and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.

accept.text: Hmm. Yes, I do have something you could do, actually. Lieutenant Doren and his followers up in the north need their regular supplies from us.$b$bThey haven't been delivered, and with the trolls attacking, I'll need someone to do it. Doren's camp lies northwest of the road at the entrance to Stranglethorn from Duskwood. Give the supplies to Private Thorsen, if he's not in the camp, then he'll be patrolling south of it. He'll take care of them.$b$bMind you, if you fail, you'll owe me restitution.

complete.text: These land mines will help us defend ourselves from that animal Kurzen and his men. Thank you for bringing them. If you need further work, I can probably find something for you to do. And you won't have to deal with those goblins, hm?

objectives.text: Deliver the Miscellaneous Goblin Supplies to Private Thorsen.

progress.text: Yes? What do you want? Oh, supplies from the goblins. Strange seeing a $r delivering them, usually they send their own. No matter... you didn't touch them did you? Good good... we wouldn't want anything to happen to our mines, oh no.

accept.text: I've gotten reports of a group of hunters that have set up camp upriver of the Venture Company mining camp on Lake Nazferiti. Now, normally I wouldn't care, but improbably, I heard that Hemet Nesingwary was one of the hunters there? He's certainly well-connected, if you catch my meaning, and you never can be too safe.$b$bWhy don't you go check out the camp, $n, see what they're about?

complete.text: Hmmm, so my information was correct, as usual. Interesting. Well, I don't suppose they pose any sort of threat of interference with our operation, but perhaps they have a need for some of our excellent manufactured products. Hmmm...

objectives.text: Find the hunters' camp and report its location to Krazek in Booty Bay.

complete.text:
Oh I see, it's a Krazek's Crock Pot!  An ingenious piece of work, but it can break a spring or throw a gear now and then.  Let me see what's wrong with this one...

Aha!  Its steam charger is rusted out, it has a cracked knuckle-gasket and its fobulator is missing teeth.  I'm surprised the pot could even boil a turnip in this state!

Can I fix it?  Of course I can fix it!

But there's a price.  Oh yes, there is always a price...

progress.text: Hello!  You brought me something?

accept.text: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate!$b$bRevilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way.$b$bMy way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.

objectives.text: Retrieve 8 Tumbled Crystals and return them to Kebok in Booty Bay.

accept.text:
The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance.  Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.

Apothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher.  Fortunately, I am such a researcher.  I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit.  When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.

objectives.text: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.

complete.text: Superb collecting, $N.

progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.

accept.text:
Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin!  What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain.  If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas.  But what we need is a test.

Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest.  Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."

objectives.text: Feed the Elixir of Pain to Stanley.

accept.text: Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.$b$bAfter softening them up, we'll proceed.$b$bUnderstood? Good. Now go.

objectives.text: Kill 14 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.

accept.text:
Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.

Bring me their heads, $N, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.

objectives.text: Kill Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus and bring their heads to Melisara in Tarren Mill.

complete.text:
Oh for the Love of the Light... they're dripping on the ground.

Can't stand touching those things, myself. Fish are all well and good, but when they grow legs and start walking around... Haven't eaten a fish in weeks, let me tell you, and in Southshore, that means you aren't eating much.

progress.text: Did you get those heads for me, $N?

accept.text: You know, $n, I'd really rather not take these heads... Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?

complete.text:
Farren's errand boy, are you?

If you assisted Farren in procuring these heads, then thank you. Southshore needs hard workers and effort to maintain its protection.

objectives.text: Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in Southshore.

progress.text: Greetings, citizen. Have you come to lend your arm to upholding the safety of Southshore?

accept.text: Please inform Lieutenant Orinelle that I would like him to refocus his efforts on the naga infesting the Eastern Strand. When he has results, tell him to report to me in person.

complete.text: The naga, eh? Redpath must have just received the same information as me... Ha! He'll not receive a promotion from my toil. Let me explain.

objectives.text: Speak with Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.

accept.text: My former mentor in the Stormwind city guard sent a message to me that Alliance High Command is becoming concerned with the threat posed by the naga. From what he's heard, there's good chances for promotion--or at least reassignment--for anyone who proves valuable in this regard.$b$bThere's just one small problem... I can't handle the naga, $n. Oh sure, I could break up a drunken barroom brawl, or haul off a belligerent beggar, but the naga are too much for me. You've got to help me, $n!

complete.text: With the naga put down in Southshore, I'll be a shoe-in to be reassigned. I'll get to see Stormwind again... get away from this Light-forsaken port.

objectives.text: Kill 10 Daggerspine Shorehunters and 10 Daggerspine Sirens for Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore.

accept.text: It shouldn't be a problem getting my report seen. The new captain of the guard, Major Samuelson, was my mentor while I was stationed in Stormwind. It should give him more than enough excuse to have me transferred back to the city. I'll need you to carry my report to him, though... wouldn't want ol' Redpath to catch on.

complete.text: What's this? Ah... so my attentive pupil has applied himself to the problem of the naga in Southshore. Thank you for bringing this to me, I will certainly take it into account when I review personnel assignments in the next month.

objectives.text: Deliver Farren's report to Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep.

progress.text: Greetings, citizen. May the Stormwind city guard be of assistance?

accept.text: "The finest leathercrafter of the South Seas and the worlds old and new." That's what they call me. Me! Drizzlik! The finest lea... Ahem. Well.$b$bMy leather goods are known far and wide as the most exquisite, a connoisseur's choice!$b$bI've just received an order from Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union for a dozen of his favorite Excelsior-line boots. Our best sellers, actually.$b$bTo start on the basic shape, I'll need crocolisk skins from the crocs along the river in northern Stranglethorn.

complete.text:
These skins should do. Their quality isn't too important, given that they'll make up the inside layer of the boots, but it's still important that they're comfortable.

If they're a bit too rigid, I'll use some tiger blood to soften it up. Tricks o' the trade, you know?

objectives.text: Bring 2 Large River Crocolisk Skins to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.

progress.text:
My equipment is all ready to go, $N, I just need those skins. We don't want to keep Riddlevox waiting, that's for sure.

It's not a good idea for anyone to keep the chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union unsatisfied.

accept.text: Well, I've got the basic shape of the boots worked out, and they're coming along fine, but the skins you brought aren't going to be quite enough for the inner layers.$b$b"What are we going to do, Drizzlik?" No doubt the question on your lips, and well, isn't it lucky you're talking to Drizzlik, because he's going to tell you what we're going to do!$b$bThe inner layers will never really be seen, so we'll just get some of the thicker, cheaper skins from the crocs around Lake Nazferiti to fill the boots out.

objectives.text: Bring 5 Snapjaw Crocolisks Skins to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.

accept.text: If there is indeed a goblin mage and water elementals haunting the island, it could mean the Stone of the Tides can be mine!$b$bI want you to locate this haunted island... find out what's going on. Oh, and if you perhaps want to find out more about the Stone of the Tides, take this scrip to the Stormwind Library, they should be able to find you a copy of the book I first came across the legend in.$b$bCould it be that Gazban actually discovered the Stone...?

objectives.text: Find the haunted island for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

complete.text: On top of the barrel, you discover a map with some hastily written text on it along with some coins.

accept.text: The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing.$b$bThe scribbled text reads:$b$b"You men are to secure a camp at this location and keep quiet.  Wait for the signal from the southern command post before attacking.  If anyone approaches you, kill them."

complete.text: Sure, I remember you, $c.  Back from scouting I see....

objectives.text: Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.

accept.text: Shiver me timbers!  So the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning some sort of attack on Booty Bay?  Why, the nerve of those scoundrels.  Booty Bay will always be run by the Blackwater Raiders!$b$bThis is bigger than I thought.  Report what you have learned to Fleet Master Seahorn at once!  The ol' sea dog is around town somewhere....

complete.text: Bloodsail Buccaneers attacking Booty Bay?  They might as well throw themselves off the Overlook Cliffs.  Nonetheless, by bringing me this information you have done my fleet of swashbucklers a great service.  The Blackwater Raiders thank you.

objectives.text: Report the planned Bloodsail attack to Fleet Master Seahorn.

accept.text: Crazz speaks highly of your dedication to the Blackwater Raiders.  I am going to trust you with a mission of extreme importance to the fleet.$b$bInfiltrate the so-called southern command post the Bloodsail Buccaneers have established on the Wild Shore.  Raid the encampment.  Bring me their charts along with their written orders.  We shall see exactly what those scum are up to.

objectives.text: Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill 10 Bloodsail Swashbucklers and bring back the Bloodsail Charts and the Bloodsail Orders.

accept.text: If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts!  And there are a lot of people who owe me. Think you can help me collect?$B$BFirst, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks.  He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due!  But to get it, we'll have to scare him.$B$BGo out of town and hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas.  Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky.  Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.

objectives.text: Bring 5 Mistvale Giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe in Booty Bay.

accept.text: Baron Revilgaz has had me keep an ear out for rumors of the strange and out-of-place in Booty Bay and Stranglethorn. I don't usually put much stock in ghost stories, but I heard some sailors in the tavern talking about a haunted island off the coast. Water elementals and a raving goblin ghost, they say.$b$bIf you're going to go talk to Revilgaz, could you relay that story to him?

complete.text:
Interesting. Some time ago, I seem to remember reading a book once that suggested...

Ah, of course, a troll legend it was. If what Krazek reports is true, perhaps I will soon be able to add the Stone of the Tides to my collection of ancient artifacts and relics.

objectives.text: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.

accept.text: Zanzil the Outcast dwells with his followers in the Jubuwai and Aboraz Ruins, northeast of Booty Bay.  He is exiled from his tribe.  Why? Well...$B$BZanzil has methods of bending the minds of others, and his leaders fear him.  He uses a mixture of jungle plants on his followers to suppress their will and strengthen their bodies.$B$BHis mixture would be worth much to those who wish to control others.$B$BBring me samples of his mixture, and I will find a use for them.

objectives.text: Bring 12 samples of Zanzil's Mixture to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.

accept.text: There is a mountain cave in Drywhisker Gorge, far to the north in the Arathi Highlands.  In that cave is rare ore: bloodstone.  The bloodstone in this cave is not of the highest grade, but even low-quality bloodstone is valuable... to those with the knowledge to use it.$B$BI would like some.$B$BI will fix your crock pot, but while I work on it... bring me samples of bloodstone.  Bring me enough, and I'll even give you a bonus.$B$BOh, and if you don't have the skill to mine it... find someone who does!

objectives.text: Bring 4 loads of Lesser Bloodstone Ore to Krazek in Booty Bay.

complete.text:
Ah, so you know Malton?  He is an old drinking companion of mine.  You see, I have found something that transcends the boundaries of artificial treaties and alliances - alcohol.  Were we all to slake our thirsts on its blissful qualities, we all would be in a much better place spiritually.

Alas, something tells me that your visit here is not to learn of alcohol's redeeming values, now is it.
You are as strong as a kodo, and your lust for battle does your people proud.

accept.text:
The head of the beast is ready to be taken off... with great force, $N. You have shown every sign that you are able to help us with this final mighty blow. The leaders of these attacks have made their lair within the ruins of Stromgarde, a glaring symbol of human frailty.

Find and slay those Boulderfist lords and their lackey shaman who would try and drive us from these lands.

objectives.text: Kill 15 Boulderfist Shaman and 10 Boulderfist Lords and return to Drum Fel in the Hammerfall outpost.

complete.text:
I will analyze this data immediately.  Perhaps Keever's insanity will prove to be my genius after all.

As for you...  you are useful to me, and I reward quite well those who remain useful.  Take this item, this coin, and most importantly my thanks along with them.

Check back with me from time to time - I wager that our working together on this project is not at an end.

progress.text: Welcome back.  At least, welcome back if you have returned with a sealed testing kit.  Otherwise, I will pretend not to notice your utter incompetence and spare my wrath from you until you do as you have been tasked and accomplish my task.

accept.text: Excuse me $c, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.$B$BThe Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project.  While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research.$B$BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.

complete.text: Greetings, $c; I am glad you are interested in assisting our research.  There is much to do, and I would be doing you a disservice if I informed you that the work this entails is not dangerous.  Hopefully this will not scare you off... but from the looks of you, I take it that danger is something that you have dealt with before.

objectives.text: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

complete.text:
Vorrel led such a troubled existence. And what a good mate he was...

Damn those filthy humans!

Vorrel is gone, never to enjoy undeath again. At least I can take solace in the revenge you took in his name. For that I thank you.

Now let me be to mourn....

progress.text: What do you want, stranger?

complete.text: Just take a look at this beauty! Fifteen pounds of solid seaforium power! Once I get this strapped on to the side of my racer, I'll be around the track so fast I'll beat the gnomes twice!

progress.text: How'm I supposed to show my face around the track without a little extra kick to get me going? It's a travesty, I tell you.

accept.text: But wait, what's this? Shreev left the safety on. That will limit the amount of power I can draw from the booster at any time. I told him I wanted it off! This is no good.$b$bYou have to take this to the Gadgetzan Gizmorium in the Tanaris Desert and have Shreev remove this.

complete.text: Only Razzeric would take a look at this and say that I'd somehow put some sort of safety lock on it. This booster is almost completely seaforium explosives. I already modified it so that more of its payload would be delivered upon use, but Razzeric is never content unless he goes to eleven!

objectives.text: Bring the Seaforium Booster to Shreev in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: As I'm sure you know, the Gizmorium can service all of your tinkering needs! How can I help you?

accept.text:
There, I did what Razzeric wanted. Just tell him to be careful when he sets this off. If he makes the slightest mistake, he won't be moving forward, he'll just be a burnt spot on the track.

Would be a shame, too, if that happened. Who knows if our nineteenth driver would be any good?

complete.text:
Now that's more like it! I wish I could see the look on the gnomes' eyes when they see me set this baby off.

Too bad I'll be too busy pulling off a new course record!

objectives.text: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.

progress.text: Can you believe Pozzik put a bucket of sand on the racer? How am I supposed to hit my maximum speed with a bucket of sand under the seat?

complete.text:
Very good, $N.

I am sure the hunt was not easy, but it is good to know the beast's pain has finally ended.

progress.text: Do you have the tooth of Deadmire, $N?  Have you ended the creature's suffering?

accept.text: Be still, $c, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious.$B$BWe are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways.$B$BIf the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.

complete.text:
Putanni, noble $c. I am Keldran, student of magic... and other mystical arts.

The business Craven sent you here to speak to me about requires a touch more subtlety than you've previously needed, but that does not mean you can not still aid our cause.

Please, make yourself comfortable, and I shall tell you why the Warchief has need of my aid... and yours.

It starts with appearances, $N. How the Horde sees itself. How our allies see us. And most importantly, how our enemies see us.

objectives.text: Speak to Keldran in Orgrimmar.

accept.text: As the Alliance progresses deeper and deeper into Kalimdor, incorrect conclusions may be drawn about the Horde making pacts with the Burning Legion. The Warchief cannot allow that to happen. And with his blessing, I am taking control of overseeing them removed.$B$BI have agents in the area of Desolace at the Ghost Walker Post north of the great Kodo Graveyard. Head south of the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains and you shall come across it. When you arrive, seek out Takata Steelblade.

objectives.text: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.

complete.text:
You place the egg... distress beacon... inside the chicken... homing robot.

Hums and whirs are heard from inside the robot as it struggles to stand up.  After the robot comes to life, Oglethorpe's voice is heard once more, but now from inside the robot:

"OOX-22/FE is working at least, but it needs major repairs!  It is much too heavy for you to carry it... but I think I have an idea.  Are you up for watching over it some more?"

progress.text:
You appear to have uncovered the wreckage of... a robotic chicken?  The voice from within the egg crackles to life again:

"Yes, excellent work!  This is indeed my homing robot, though my sensors indicate that it needs a jump start before it can fly back to Booty Bay for repairs.  Go ahead and place the beacon inside the rover - the beacon will take care of the rest!"

accept.text: The gnome's voice crackles once again from the robot:$B$B"I need to move OOX-22/FE to an open, safe place so it can begin a lengthy take-off procedure.  It has built-in cloaking, but I need time on my end to make it operational again.  Escort the robot from its current location to, let's say, the dock along the Forgotten Coast!  That should be a perfect place, and long enough, to get things online!"$B$B"Escort it safely to the dock, and then come talk to me in Booty Bay!  Oglethorpe Obnoticus - out!"

objectives.text: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

accept.text: Sergeant Bly stole from me!  He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!!  Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes??$B$BFind Bly and bring me my rod!  I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west.  I bet you'll find him there.$B$BLet's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.

complete.text: You found it!  Well done, $N!  Did you have to fight Bly for it?  I hope you knocked him and his band down good and hard!

objectives.text: Bring the Divino-matic Rod to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Did you find Sergeant Bly?  Did you get my divino-matic rod?

accept.text: Deep in Zul'Farrak, the sand troll city in Tanaris, there is a sacred pool.  From that pool the trolls summon a huge beast!  Gahz'rilla!  He's so fierce that even his scales crackle with energy.  It's that energy I want to harness for my car!$B$BBring me the electrified scale of Gahz'rilla!$B$BBut the summoning of Gahz'rilla is a well-kept secret of the trolls.  To face him, you must first wrest the secret from them.

complete.text:
Wow, you got the scale!  Thanks, $N.  I can't wait to get to work on this thing!

So you saw Gahz'rilla?  Was he as big as they say??

objectives.text: Bring Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.

progress.text: Do you have the scale?  I can't wait to try different ways to harness its energy!

accept.text: I take pride in my leather work, and I feel it shows; quality should never be compromised.  Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter would also have you believe that the earth does not keep secrets!$B$BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have discovered thick yeti hides.  Yetis are native to Feralas, often found west of here in Feral Scar Vale.  I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten.  If that is agreeable to you, then we are set!

complete.text:
Ah, excellent!  These hides, when given a special treatment, are as resilient as iron I tell you!  It will take many tries in order to get the right mix down for the tanning, but I am confident they will bring my mark of quality to the next level.

As for you, $N... your assistance has proven invaluable to me.  Please take your choice from these items I have crafted.

objectives.text: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
Were you able to get a stack of ten thick yeti hides?  My leather goods are second to none, and I'll share a sampling with you should you have the hides.

If you can't seem to find yetis, I know where some might be.  Try looking west of here, just inland of the Forgotten Coast around the Feral Scar Vale.

accept.text: Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the Tiara of the Deep.  And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.$B$BSo when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it.  She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away.  The thieves!$B$BI want my tiara back!  Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in Tanaris, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her.  Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.

complete.text:
Wonderful!  You found it!  And what's just as important--Velratha no longer has it!  Thank you, $N.  I am forever in your debt!

And if I sounded a little... mean before, pay it no mind.  You'll find me a much nicer person to those who haven't stolen from me.

objectives.text: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

progress.text: Do you have the tiara, $N?  Has Velratha learned the price of crossing me?

accept.text: $n, your skill as a leatherworker precedes you.  I possess leatherworking lore you would be wise to acquire... Wild Leather armor!  Wild Leather taps into the potent and chaotic properties of wildvines, found in areas of lush vegetation and on some of the creatures there.  Armor made using it is second to none for a crafter of your skill, guaranteed.$B$BI'll teach you, but you'll be working for me for a while.  The first cost is simply ten pieces of thick leather.  After this, we'll talk specifics.

complete.text:
Well $N, I'm glad to have you on board as my apprentice.  You've made a wise decision as a leatherworker; those who make use of leather armor will be clamoring to you once you learn how to master the art of Wild Leather.

Let's get to work - where do you want to start?

objectives.text: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
We must be clear; you shall be apprenticed to me while you learn the art of Wild Leather armor.  Because wildvines are both potent and chaotic, it yields a random but strong benefit to the already strong armor you will be making.  This knowledge, however, was not easy for me to acquire.

The initial cost to begin this process is ten pieces of thick leather.

Once that is done, we'll get to the work you need to do in order to obtain the patterns.

accept.text:
Wild Leather shoulders support a wearer's frame extremely well, offering superior protection of the upper arms as well as the shoulders.  As with all Wild Leather armor, a random yet very potent enhancement is imbued within the item as the wildvine is stitched in.

For this pattern, I will require six thick armor kits and a wildvine.  That shouldn't be too tall of an order for you to fill.

complete.text:
These armor kits are of solid quality, $N.  If there is one thing I demand in not only my work, but in the work of those I give tutelage to, it is quality.

You've done well to earn this pattern; I hope it brings you the rewards it has brought me.

objectives.text: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
Do you have the six thick armor kits and the wildvine I require?

Think of making armor kits as a lesson in steady and reliable crafting; the consistent fashioning method you develop as you ply your trade on these kits helps develop your skills for the intricate work needed to make Wild Leather armors.

Every lesson has a purpose, $N.  It is important to embrace each one accordingly.

accept.text: Wild Leather vests are the staple of any Wild Leather armor set.  The frame of the vest and the wildvine weave within it produces a product that offers maximum protection of the torso while allowing for potent magic to work its way through the garment.$B$BFor this pattern, I will require two Turtle Scale breastplates, two sets of Turtle Scale gloves, and a wildvine.  This is not an easy lesson, but it is one you certainly have the skill to complete.

complete.text:
These are some very nice pieces here, $N.  The craftsmanship and care put in to making these show you have chosen to dedicate yourself fully to these tasks.

You've met my requests, and with that comes your reward.  The knowledge of making Wild Leather vests is now yours!

objectives.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
Do you have the two Turtle Scale breastplates and gloves?  Also, don't forget the wildvine!

Even with the earliest patterns, we learn that the fundamentals of shape translate well into more difficult garments.  Though different items, the shape of the Turtle Scale breastplates prepares you for the detailing needed to make a Wild Leather vest.

As you progress through your lessons, the skills I teach will become as art.

accept.text:
A Wild Leather helmet offers the wearer superior protection to the vital areas of the head without a sacrifice in comfort.  As with all Wild Leather armor, the integrated wildvine yields a powerful but random magic imbuement to the helm's frame.  Leather wearers will definitely want this piece!

For this pattern, I will need two Nightscape tunics, 2 Nightscape headbands, and a wildvine.  Complete this lesson and the pattern will be yours!

complete.text:
This Nightscape equipment you have supplied perfectly meets the requirements I have given to you, $N.  I expect no less from a leatherworker of your caliber.

You have earned the honor of crafting Wild Leather helmets.  I give this pattern to you freely, and hope you will profit from it accordingly.

objectives.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
I need those tunics and headbands made, and I also need that piece of wildvine before I will share with you the knowledge of Wild Leather helmets.

Head gear is highly coveted amongst adventurers, whether it be a disarmingly simple headband or a full-covering helmet.  The fundamentals of creating valued head gear remain constant, no matter what the cosmetic appearance of the gear is.

accept.text: Your knowledge of Wild Leather armor grows, $n; still, there is more for you to learn.$B$BWild Leather boots are the cornerstone of any set.  Such boots are crafted to cradle the foot in comfort while bracing it against the hazards of adventuring.  The soft soles are a blessing to those seeking quiet movement in footwear.$B$BFor this pattern, I need two Nightscape pants and two Nightscape boots crafted.  I also will require two wildvines... not just one.  When you have these items, we will proceed.

complete.text: Once again, you have produced items with the skill of a seasoned professional.  You have earned this pattern, as well as my congratulations.

objectives.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
The pants, boots, and wildvines need to be delivered to me before you learn the pattern, $N.  Have you done as I asked?

From the earliest pair of boots we learn how to make, we start to understand that a quality boot needs to ride a razor's edge between comfort and function.  With both, we are able to create items that allow the wearer to ignore fatigue that would cripple those wearing lower quality goods.

accept.text:
You are ready to master more complex lessons, $N.  Wild Leather leggings are some of the sturdiest and powerful leather gear around.  The waist, thighs, calves, and the vitals - all are given tremendous protection.  Coupled with the enhancement that the wildvine provides, adventurers who own it will thank you each time they see you.

For you to gain this pattern, I need two Turtle Scale helms, two Turtle Scale bracers, and two wildvines.

complete.text:
Again, you've completed my task without flaw.  Perhaps some day I will come to YOU seeking knowledge, eh $N?

Here is the pattern for the leggings, along with my thanks.  Commit this lore to your knowledge, and let your finished products tap into your impressive skills!

objectives.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

progress.text:
Do you have the Turtle Scale bracers and helms ready?  Don't forget the two wildvines I require.

By now, you're starting to realize the potential power that lies in Wild Leather armor.  An armor that has no boundaries in application is nearly invaluable to a leatherworker.  The limits are only in the quantities of resources to make the items - not the quality of the finished products!

accept.text: $n, you have learned all I am able to teach you.  There is, however, one remaining pattern for Wild Leather armor.  I will not require you to toil needlessly for this; you've earned it outright, and then some.  This pattern, however, is one that I cannot freely share with you.$B$BMy teacher, the one who brought me into the craft, is the one who must reward you.  Take this note to Una; she teaches leatherworking in Thunder Bluff.  Show her the letter, and let her acknowledge you as an equal, as I do.

objectives.text: Give Jangdor's Letter to Una, the master leatherworker of Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: The scarabs of Tanaris have very hard shells!  Hard enough to use as a building material for lots of things.  So many things!$B$BIn fact, those shells are so useful... the scarabs were hunted all to near extinction!$B$BI know where there are more scarabs, and if you promise to bring me their shells then I'll tell you where they are.  Promise?$B$BOk, the scarabs have a colony in Zul'Farrak.  I guess the trolls don't hunt them for their shells.$B$BBut you can!  Go to Zul'Farrak and get me uncracked shells!

complete.text:
Oh, great!  You got them!

Thanks, $N.  You're a real lifesaver!

objectives.text: Bring 5 Uncracked Scarab Shells to Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Do you have the shells?  My cousin in Booty Bay is waiting for a load of them, and he's getting impatient!

accept.text: These bottles hold a vile, green venom.$B$BConsidering the number of bottles in this village, the Witherbarks must deem it very important.  Perhaps an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill would like a sample.

complete.text: Ah, and what is this?  It appears to be venom... from some arachnoid creature I deem.  And where did you get it?

objectives.text: Bring a Venom Bottle to an apothecary in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Hello, gentle $c.  The day has been long and not a single experiment successful...I hope you bring good news to me.

accept.text: I must have a fresh sample of the venom you brought me.  The spiders from which it was gathered must dwell in the Hinterlands -- hunt them until you find an undamaged venom sac and bring it to me.  You will find many spiders near the troll city of Shadra'Alor.$B$BDo not tarry, $n, for the venom sac must be fresh when you deliver it.

complete.text: Oh, splendid!  The venom is quite fresh and I'm sure very deadly.  Thank you!

objectives.text: Bring an Undamaged Venom Sac to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

progress.text: Do you have the undamaged venom sac, $N?  I yearn to run experiments with its fresh venom, and have ordered a collection of small, terribly cute animals on which to test it!

accept.text: The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally.  It must have come from a different spider.$B$BI want a fresh sample of that venom.  To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.  Travel to Durotar and speak with Gadrin.  With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.

complete.text: Ah, so you want fresh venom from the spider of the witherbarks, yes?  Well, sit down... you're not going to like what I have to tell you.

objectives.text: Speak with Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village.

accept.text: The Witherbarks worship a spider god, and from her they collect their most potent venom.  So if you want the venom, then you must summon their god!$B$BTo do that, you must know her true name, and that name is on a tablet buried in Tanaris, in the troll city of Zul'Farrak, in a tomb guarded by Theka the Martyr.$B$BDefeat Theka and find and read his tablet to discover the spider god's name.  When you know it, return to me.

complete.text:
Ah, Elortha no Shadra... speak this name only in whispers, for its utterance carries much weight in the realms of the spirit.

I will put it to parchment and create for you a spell of summoning...

objectives.text: Read from the Tablet of Theka to learn the name of the Witherbark spider god, then return to Master Gadrin.

accept.text: Take his parchment, and read it at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep within the witherbark realm in the Hinterlands.  This will summon Shadra the spider god.

objectives.text: Defeat Shadra at the altar of Shadra'Alor, then bring her venom to Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

complete.text:
The Grimtotem!? This is interesting. You say you came across them while hunting in Feralas? Truly?

My peers will want to hear your news, $c. Tell me more and I'll count out your coin while you do so.

And before you go, know that I give you thanks for the information you've passed on to me this day.

progress.text: Be quick, $c, I have much to complete today.

complete.text: This orb will provide us with more information about the Gordunni... which we will then use in planning their downfall, $N.

progress.text: We must discover more about why the Gordunni are here, $N.

complete.text: You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, $N.

accept.text: Although I know my enemy well, I am a warrior, $n. I cannot begin to tell you what this orb is capable of.$B$BI know of a mage in Orgrimmar that will be able to tell us more about the orb. Take it to him.

complete.text:
Fascinating, $N...

This orb is very powerful, but also very dangerous.

objectives.text: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

progress.text: What have you brought me, skyborne?

accept.text: The Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak make a tempering agent from sandstones, and I can use that to temper the goods I craft, yes I can!  It is highly prized by connoisseurs, so if you bring me a good supply of the temper, then I'll reward you well.$B$BZul'Farrak is northwest of Gadgetzan.  Good luck.

complete.text:
Ah, this is very nice temper indeed!  And so much of it!  I'll be at work for days before I use it all!

Thank you, $N.  Please, take this as payment.

objectives.text: Bring 20 Vials of Troll Temper to Trenton Lighthammer in Gadgetzan.

progress.text: Did you bring me the temper, $N?

accept.text: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. She is pure evil; I have heard that her heart is one of crystal. She is void of any emotion aside from the hate she feels towards all others. You must face Edana and bring me back her dark heart.$B$BI have heard of a horn that harpies carry -- blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon the queen.$B$BImagine her surprise when it is not her kin calling her, but her death.

objectives.text: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.

accept.text: In my day, I was a seasoned hunter. There wasn't any creature around that I feared. Until...$B$BI was out in the forest, sharpening my blade after a tough battle, when I was ambushed. Harpies surrounded me, and I barely managed to drag myself to safety.$B$BEven now, I can still hear their cries echoing...$B$BI was never the same after that. But the hate boils inside of me -- I must get even, after all these years.$B$BThe Northspring harpies can be found to the west of here. $n, get my revenge.

objectives.text: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.

complete.text:
I have been waiting for Uzer'i to deliver this...

Let me give you the herb mixture I prepared for his... well, experiments...

progress.text: Yes?

accept.text: Here are the herbs, $n. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.$B$BPlease let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.

complete.text:
This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, $N.  Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.

Please, a moment. I must perform the ritual and apply the herbs.

objectives.text: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

progress.text: Have you spoken to Neeru?

accept.text: This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. Take this vessel, $n. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it.$B$BTravel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess Elune. The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, $n. Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.

objectives.text: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.$B$BBring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

accept.text: I will need certain materials to complete my endeavor... You may do this alongside the other tasks I will give you.$B$BI'll need a splintered log from a treant of Feralas. Encrusted minerals, these can be found on the mountain giants and faerie dragons to the west. Also, find me some resilient sinew from the owlbeasts of the Hinterlands or hippogryphs of Feralas. Finally, I'll need a large amount of metallic fragments from any of these creatures I mentioned.

objectives.text: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

accept.text: Have you ever seen Thistleshrub Valley? It's a mighty dangerous place, $n.$B$BThose strange beasts there, I don't trust them for a minute! Gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, that's what I think they were called...$B$BAnyhow, I want to get into the valley, but with so many of those thistleshrubs around, there's no way I'm going back there. But here's where you come in -- if you clear some of them out, I just might think about going back. What do you think, $n? Help me out?

objectives.text: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants you to kill 8 Gnarled Thistleshrubs and 8 Thistleshrub Rootshapers.

complete.text:
You have done well, $N.  Perhaps now it is time to reveal more...

There is an ancient prophecy among the trolls, where the dead god Hakkar, the Soulflayer, will one day return to this earth.  Some say the coming of Hakkar will bring joy and glory to trollkind, while others believe his resurrection marks the end of all things.

I do not believe this myth, but I do know the essence of Hakkar holds great power, and this power should be kept from those who would abuse it...

progress.text: Have you collected the essence of the screecher spirits, $N?

accept.text: The ancient prophecy of Mosh'aru speaks of a way to contain the god Hakkar's essence.  It was written on two tablets and taken to the troll city of Zul'Farrak, west of Gadgetzan.$B$BBring me the Mosh'aru tablets!$B$BThe first tablet is held by the long-dead troll Theka the Martyr.  It is said his persecutors were cursed into scarabs and now scuttle about his shrine.$B$BThe second tablet is held by the hydromancer Velratha, near the sacred pool of Gahz'rilla.$B$BWhen you have the tablets, bring them to me.

complete.text:
Ah, this is good.  I can fuse these ancient tablets together, and then study their hidden secrets.

My debt to you grows, $N.  And it will grow further still.

objectives.text: Bring the First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

progress.text:
Do you have the tablets of the Prophecy of Mosh'aru, $N?

When I gain the tablets, I will study them, and learn how to contain the essence of Hakkar!

accept.text: See that tauren behind me--the one who looks like she's going to be ill at any moment? She was in Azshara recently. She claims she was wounded by some naga while making her way through the Ruins of Eldarath.$B$BAfter fighting off a few of them, she took a break on the beach and drank from one of the tide pools. Now she's feeling nauseous... among other things.$B$BI'd like to find out what she drank. Take this box, in it are some empty vials I labeled. Fill each at different pools and come back.

objectives.text: Fill all 4 Empty Vials at the tide pools along the coast of the Ruins of Eldarath in Azshara before returning to Chemist Cuely.

accept.text:
The soil of Un'Goro Crater is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities.  The Cenarion Circle wants to study this soil in large quantities; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough of it for our continued research.

The rich soil will stick out in piles from time to time, and some of the beasts might have usable samples on their being.  Take them all outside to Ghede; just look for the piles of dirt and the tauren barking orders.  He means well, just don't get him riled up though!

objectives.text: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Ghede on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

accept.text: I'm always looking for a quick way to earn a gold, $n. If you help me with my newest idea, I'll let you in on a little of the profit. How does that sound to you?$B$BI thought so!$B$BHead to the tar pits in northern Un'Goro Crater, and collect me some tar. Not just any tar, now, you'll need to get it from the beasts that live around the tar pits. Regular tar just simply isn't sticky enough.$B$BThe plant-like creatures contain chlorophyll in their skin, and mixed with the tar, it's super sticky!

objectives.text: Collect 12 samples of Super Sticky Tar for Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.

accept.text: Vivian Lagrave sent me word from Kargath, in the Badlands.  Through her studies, she believes there is an ancient text within Blackrock Spire that would benefit our research.  To confirm this, she will need someone to extract the text from the spire.  No easy task.$B$BIf interested, then speak with Vivian in Kargath.

objectives.text: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.
